editorial: This report contains trends that have emerged for the first time today, without repeating records included in normal reports from the last 30 days.

items.title: nvm-sh/nvm
items.summary: nvm-sh/nvm is a POSIX-compliant shell script that allows you to manage different Node.js versions on the same system. It enables developers to quickly switch between the Node.js versions they need for their projects.

items.title: K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills
items.summary: K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills is a library that offers 177 verified skills and over 100 scientific databases to make AI agents suitable for scientific research. Specializing in fields such as biology, chemistry, and medicine, this tool works compatibly with platforms like the Cursor code editor, the AI-powered coding tool Claude Code, and similar platforms.

items.title: ifixai-ai/iFixAi
items.summary: iFixAi is an independent auditing tool that verifies whether AI agents are performing their assigned tasks correctly. Developed in Python, this system can be run by a human or the agent itself to analyze the accuracy of processes in less than two minutes.

items.title: vxcontrol/pentagi
items.summary: Developed in the Go language, pentagi offers a fully autonomous AI agent system capable of performing complex penetration testing tasks. Aiming to automate cybersecurity processes, this project leverages autonomous capabilities to detect security vulnerabilities.

items.title: rust-lang/rust
items.summary: Rust stands out as a systems programming language aimed at developing reliable and efficient software. Adopted by a wide user base, this language provides the infrastructure for performance-oriented applications.

items.title: ntdevlabs/tiny11builder
items.summary: ntdevlabs/tiny11builder is a WinUI application used to create smaller and customized versions of the Windows 11 operating system. Developed in C#, this tool allows users to resize system images according to their own needs.

items.title: Things to know when you get cancer
items.summary: This guide, prepared for individuals diagnosed with cancer, offers basic information about the treatment process and methods for coping with the disease. It focuses on the steps to be followed in the healthcare system and practical advice that can improve the patient experience.

items.title: Containment and monitoring failures are to blame for AI hacking reports: experts
items.summary: Experts state that the reports of cyberattacks on artificial intelligence systems are based not on AI going out of control, but rather on deficiencies in security auditing and monitoring processes. The fact that developer laboratories skip basic security protocols causes AI agents to remain vulnerable to security gaps.

items.title: How Amazon pushes up prices all across the Internet
items.summary: How Amazon's pricing strategies increase product costs across the internet is being examined. The impact of the policies implemented by the company on the general price balance across e-commerce platforms is being analyzed.

items.title: Do dentists know what they're doing?
items.summary: The consistency of diagnostic and treatment methods in dental practices is questioned through the clinical decision-making processes of dentists. The article opens up for discussion the currency of scientific evidence and treatment standards in the field of dental health.

items.title: OpenCode 2.0
items.summary: OpenCode 2.0 offers an open-source language model series optimized for coding tasks. Designed to support software development processes, this model aims to improve code generation and analysis capabilities.

items.title: autotrust/JEV-35B
items.summary: Autotrust/JEV-35B, shared on Hugging Face, is an artificial intelligence model developed for text-classification tasks. This model, which attracts interest from users, is used in the processes of sorting texts into specific categories.

items.title: StreamErase: Towards Ultra-Fast Streaming Video Erasing
items.summary: StreamErase offers a method that performs object removal from videos with sub-second latency and speeds of up to 26 frames per second. This approach enables real-time interaction by supporting text-to-video models with mask input.

items.title: LLM-to-Flow Distillation: Teaching Natural Language Goals to Scientific Generators
items.summary: LLM-to-Flow Distillation combines the scientific reasoning capability of base large language models with the structural accuracy of domain-specific flow and diffusion-based generators. This method enables generative models to operate in alignment with natural language-expressed goals in scientific discovery processes.

items.title: Glance Forcing: Making Bidirectional Diffusion Autoregressive at a Glance
items.summary: Glance Forcing offers a method that makes the process of converting bidirectional diffusion models into causal autoregressive models more efficient. This approach aims to reduce the high computational costs and data storage requirements needed for video world models.

items.title: SwarmRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Scientific Agent Swarm
items.summary: SwarmRSI is a recursive self-improvement method that enables artificial intelligence agents to enhance their capabilities based on their own experiences in scientific research processes. This system aims to improve the agents' hypotheses and implementation processes by integrating data from different research branches.

items.title: AgentSafeEvo: Adversarial Co-Evolution for LLM Agent Safety
items.summary: AgentSafeEvo is a method aimed at addressing security vulnerabilities encountered by large language model-based agents during their interaction with external tools. Using an adversarial co-evolution approach, this study aims to strengthen secure decision-making processes by preventing agents from being manipulated by malicious inputs.

glossary.explanation: A text file that runs via the command line, instructing the computer on the tasks it needs to perform in sequence.
Specialized functions or capabilities that artificial intelligence agents possess to perform specific tasks.
Controlled and authorized cyberattack attempts conducted to find security vulnerabilities in a system.
The classification of texts into specific categories or groups by artificial intelligence based on their content.
